# Curate reference genome data
```{r}
samples <- read_tsv("./scripts/CoverageStats_shared_scripts/sample_NG_pilot.tsv") %>% .$sample_id
genotypes <- list.files("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/database/gene_references/") %>% str_split(.,"\\.",simplify=T) %>% .[,1] %>% unique

summary_statistics <- lapply(samples,FUN=function(x){
  pbmcapply::pbmclapply(genotypes,FUN=function(y){
    read_tsv(paste0("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/gene_coverage/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_",y,"/",x,"/gatk/",x,"_CoverageStats_summary.txt"))
  },mc.cores = 10) %>% do.call(rbind,.)
  
}) %>% do.call(rbind,.) %>% mutate(reference_location = 'Pathogenwatch')

summary_statistics$genotype <- summary_statistics$reference %>% gsub("CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_","",.)

saveRDS(summary_statistics,"./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_summary_statistics.RDS")
```

# Curate overall gene data
```{r}
gene_position_data <- lapply(samples,FUN=function(x){
  pbmcapply::pbmclapply(genotypes,FUN=function(y){
    read_csv(paste0("./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/gene_coverage/CoverageStats_NG_pilot_PathogenWatch_gene_",y,"/",x,"/gatk/",x,"_summary")) %>% select(Locus,Total_Depth) 
  },mc.cores = 10) %>% do.call(rbind,.) %>% mutate(isolate=x)
  
}) %>% do.call(rbind,.) %>% mutate(reference_location = 'Pathogenwatch')

gene_position_data$genotype <- gene_position_data$Locus %>% str_split(.,":",simplify=T) %>% .[,1]
gene_position_data$position <-   gene_position_data$Locus %>% str_split(.,":",simplify=T) %>% .[,2] %>% as.numeric

saveRDS(gene_position_data,"./data/PathogenWatch_AMR_coverage/coverage/curated_datasets/Pathogenwatch_gene_coverage_by_position.RDS")
```
